environment: Linux; HTTP LAN origin mapped to loopback; no Wi-Fi hardware certification

steps.name: Local teacher bootstrap, real profile and complete database
Create seminar and show reachable LAN invitation
Two-field touch entry automatically joins the linked seminar over HTTP LAN
Shared territory, HTTP SHA checks and manual statistics correction
Frozen DOCX/PDF/JSON export with fonts entirely from local server
Local PDF source preserves its edition and serves bytes without an external host
Independent anonymous LAN form uses native fetch without account credentials
Consistent backup, real server restart and restored account
Logout and the same email on a fresh device resume the sole open seminar and preserved authorship
A different email in the same browser receives a separate identity and never rewrites prior authorship
